verdict.rationale: Remote's authentication docs say to use a separate token per integration so each can be scoped and revoked independently, and OAuth flows let an app act on behalf of companies that grant consent. Together these give a basis for issuing an agent its own limited credential, but the evidence never describes which scopes exist or how granular they are. Missing for 10: a documented list of scopes and their granularity (e.g. read-only or per-resource permissions), agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
